description: Delete and restore files, Ctrl + C, V, Z, S and the files exam

learn.intro: Today we learn you can't break a computer by deleting a file, get superpowers and pass an exam!

slides.text: A deleted file doesn't vanish forever — it falls into the **Recycle Bin**, like paper in a wastebasket. Until it's emptied, you can take it back.
Delete: right-click → Delete or the **Delete** key. Restore: open the Bin → right-click → **Restore**.
You can't break a computer by deleting a file. Just **never empty the Bin without a grown-up**.

check.prompt: How do you get a file back from the Bin?

slides.text: Pro secret combos are like superpowers: **Ctrl + C** — copy, **Ctrl + V** — paste.
**Ctrl + Z** is a time machine: it undoes the last action. **Ctrl + S** saves.

check.explain: Ctrl + Z undoes the last thing.

slides.text: Mini exam: make an Exam folder → save a My day file in it → rename it → copy it to the desktop → delete the copy → restore it from the Bin.
You do it all yourself, no hints. If it doesn't work — we'll practise and you'll retake it perfectly!
